{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing any potential commas
# First, check for commas in revenue values
column_with_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print("Rows with commas in revenue:", column_with_commas.sum())

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
# But since no commas are found, just cast to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].astype(float)

# Check for the QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print("Number of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99):", len(qa_orders))

# Remove QA orders
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99].copy()

# Check number of rows after removal
print("Rows after removing QA orders:", len(df_clean))"}
